item.title: A Second Look: Remembering the Best of Charlie Kirk (Ad-Free)
item.description:
While terrible people like Jennifer Welch and Dave Chappelle are trashing Charlie Kirk's legacy this week, Megyn Kelly looks back at the special put together of Charlie's best appearances on The Megyn Kelly Show over the years.
